# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

This repository's conventions live in one file: **`CLAUDE.md`**, at the repository root. Read it before suggesting or
reviewing a change.

This file is a pointer, not a copy, so the conventions exist once and cannot drift. It used to be a symlink to `CLAUDE.md`,
but Jenkins rejects a pipeline library that contains a symlink, and this repository is one (`vars/darnlinkGate.groovy`).
